name: session-journal
description: Record Codex and Claude Code sessions to an Obsidian vault (or a subfolder of an existing one): an append-only raw event log plus one regenerated summary note per session — no verbatim transcript, no auto-generated wiki. Every note is tagged #ai-generated to stay distinct from hand-authored notes. Portable name-based vault resolution (with an explicit-pin guard against duplicate same-named vaults) for multi-machine setups synced via Obsidian Sync.

interface.shortDescription: Record agent sessions into an Obsidian vault.
interface.longDescription: Capture Claude Code and Codex prompts, tool activity, and final results through lifecycle hooks; write an append-only raw log plus one regenerated summary note per session (no verbatim transcript, no auto-generated wiki), with Obsidian wikilinks for graph navigation.
defaultPrompt: Show where session-journal writes Obsidian notes.
